reason: Primary user-facing purpose is automated cost-saving behavior control in DSH sessions: during configured Beijing peak-pricing periods it auto-switches response style and surfaces estimated token/cost savings via UI and API reporting, which positions it as a general utility/automation plugin with monitoring-style feedback.

summaries.zh: 该插件在 DeepSeek Harness 中按北京时间高峰/低谷时段自动切换为精简输出模式，并在界面与报告中展示节省相关的运行状态与估算数据。
summaries.en: This plugin automatically switches output behavior in DeepSeek Harness during configured Beijing peak-pricing windows and shows a badge, transition notices, and a savings report to track estimated token and cost impact.

capabilities: Automatically alters model output mode on a time schedule
Captures and aggregates token usage data during selected windows
Displays runtime cost-related state and summaries in the web UI
Writes/reads plugin state and configuration files under the user DSH directory
Exposes local endpoints for state, stats, and reset actions

reasons.code: README states the plugin detects Beijing-time peak windows (09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00) and applies a peak-cost output mode automatically.
README explains a host-side 30-second timer and a systemPrompt section (`peak-cost-mode`) that is registered in peak windows and disposed outside them.
README describes subscribing to `llm/stream` completions, capturing `input/cacheRead/output` usage and persisting per-window savings metrics.
README lists a client UI with header badge, transition toasts, composer readout, and a savings report panel, plus `POST /api/peak-cost/reset` and related state/stat endpoints.
README says stats are stored in `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/dsh-peak-cost-mode/stats.json` and config is loaded from `${DSH_HOME:-~/.dsh}/dsh-peak-cost-mode/config.json`.
package.json declares the plugin as a DSH web plugin (`dsh.client.platform` = `web`) and entrypoints for runtime and client code.
